name: M12-NOV-04b4k2 batch-aware compact-query result-conditioned prospective study
unresolved_fields: Complete six-pair scientific evidence and blind labels

decision_scope.question: Whether one bounded result-conditioned PubMed follow-up recovers source-backed prior art over a matched draft-only follow-up without degrading distinct-control retrieval.
decision_scope.unit: Six fixed positive/distinct-control draft pairs in bank9 order; all six pairs and all twelve drafts are mandatory.
decision_scope.claim_limit: Exploratory only. A pass requires a new independently eligible three-pair confirmatory comparison before implementation or release; a failure rejects only this frozen adaptation.
decision_scope.historical_study: Studies1–8 and consumed admissions/results are immutable, incomplete and unscored. Study9 reuses exact exposed bank9 after the compact-output design decision; this is a distinct prospectively frozen exploratory configuration, never a fresh-source or holdout claim.
decision_scope.source_sampling_limit: Exact unchanged bank9, all six fixed pairs/original order, originally prepared for study8. No new source acquisition, filtering, selection or performance screening. Dataset is exposed development data; earlier source-preparation claims apply historically only.
decision_scope.design_reference_scope: Pinned v1 is historical external-technique evidence. Study9 retains all shared-first union/dedup scientific gates with exact bank9 and symmetric compact guidance; no historical rescoring.

validation_boundary.configured_tool: first validation search-category tool: pubmed_fulltext -> pubmed_search_with_fulltext

selected_model_condition.served_model_rule: Each response must expose served_model exactly equal to openrouter/stealth/space-bunny-alpha. The route is pinned to only Stealth and allow_fallbacks=false; the request has zero prompt, completion, and request price ceilings. Missing telemetry, route mismatch, admission or price failure stops before another call; no alias, fallback, paid substitution, retry, or cache reuse.
selected_model_condition.activation_gate: After reviewed private study9 inputs, actual nonexecuting process readiness and exact committed bank9/protocol9 loaders, recheck current official zero-price catalog, active exact Stealth endpoint and read-only account projection immediately before admission. Historical eligibility does not prove current availability.

prompts.rendering_rule: Use full frozen draft in each prompt. The static prompt receives the draft only. The conditioned prompt receives that same draft plus the shared first-search result titles and available abstracts in maintained parser order; no IDs, authors, ranks, arm names, or target/anchor PMIDs are added.

response_contract.edge_whitespace: Strip only outer whitespace identically in both arms; preserve raw response.
response_contract.rejection: Reject true multiline, wrappers, unquoted JSON braces, unbalanced quotes/delimiters, unquoted dangling Boolean operators, excess query length and any frozen target/anchor identifier.
response_contract.limitation: Syntactic validity and normal stop do not prove semantic completeness.

prompts.prospective_output_guidance: Use 3-5 core search terms or short quoted phrases. Use AND/OR only where useful and keep Boolean structure compact. Do not add PubMed field tags or expand the query with synonyms.

first_search.tool: pubmed_search_with_fulltext via configured validation search tool pubmed_fulltext
first_search.query_rule: Exact full frozen draft; every draft must be at most 200 characters before admission, so the existing draft[:200] wire slice changes no input. No query rewrite, identifier injection, extra term, date filter, or result-conditioned request.
first_search.matched_evidence_rule: For each draft, issue one shared first search. Generate the static draft-only query before that first search. Then generate one candidate query from the same draft plus the exact shared result titles and available abstracts, preserving parser order. Both follow-up records link to the same first-search event; the first-search result is not separately rerun for either arm.
first_search.sort: pub_date (newest first), fixed by the pinned current MCP source tree

followups.tool: Same maintained PubMed validation tool and mapping as first search.
followups.matched_settings: Same selected route, plain-text output contract, model request options, maintained MCP source tree, tool parameters, and date-window behavior. Only first-search title/abstract visibility differs.
followups.sort: pub_date (newest first), same as first search

trace_required: metadata_batching ledger with selected IDs, cache hits, EFetch groups, returned IDs, ELink IDs and per-PMID outcomes
internal_mcp_bounds_per_outer_call.note: The 36 outer MCP tool-call ceiling is not an upstream NCBI HTTP-request ceiling. The batch ledger describes maintained metadata EFetch and ELink wrapper entries; PMC fulltext EFetch pagination is separate.
internal_mcp_bounds_per_outer_call.result_order: Maintained parser / source response order after pinned PubMed newest-first retrieval and existing fulltext-first, abstract-only fill behavior; no additional pilot ranking.
internal_mcp_bounds_per_outer_call.count_semantics: Use the raw metadata_batching ledger for exact metadata EFetch and ELink batch counts. It is not physical HTTP-wire telemetry. The batch-count comparison covers metadata retrieval only; exclude search ESearch, PMC fulltext EFetch and its retstart pages, and do not infer an aggregate or total upstream HTTP count. Selected metadata IDs remain bounded by nine; fulltext remains the existing separately paginated path.

search_design.unit: Six fixed positive/distinct-control draft pairs from fresh, independently reviewed bank9; all six pairs and all twelve drafts are mandatory.
search_design.historical_study: Prior study versions and their admissions remain immutable, incomplete or unscored as recorded, and are never replayed or rescored. This is a separately prepared eighth study with fresh bank9 inputs and the pinned batch-aware retrieval boundary.
search_design.design_reference_scope: The pinned v1 design remains historical conceptual technique evidence only. Exposed earlier banks and follow-up-only scoring are superseded for this prospective study by protocol8, fresh bank9 and unchanged shared-first union/dedup criteria. No historical protocol or result is rescored.

target_blinding.source_ids_location: Scorer-only fields in frozen bank9; the runner derives them locally for guard checks.
runner_checks: Reject a generated prompt or query containing any frozen target/anchor PMID before PubMed dispatch.
Reject retrieved title/abstract text containing a frozen target/anchor PMID.
Retain result PMIDs only in the private result/provenance report for scoring; omit PMIDs and arm/rank labels from the blind packet.

blinding.review_unit: Each returned paper from all shared first-search and arm-specific follow-up calls, paired with its full frozen draft. The shared first-search items are labeled for context but excluded from arm-comparison unrelated-paper fractions.
blinding.process: The packet contains random blind IDs, drafts, titles, and abstracts only and is shuffled by blind ID. Label before revealing any arm, rank, PMID, target, or anchor. Use only arm-specific follow-up items for static-versus-candidate unrelated-paper fractions; the LLM relevance judgment may supplement but never replace exact-ID retrieval scoring.

outcome_criteria.primary: Across the six positive drafts, compare exact target-PMID coverage in shared-first-search union candidate-follow-up results against the matched shared-first-search union static-follow-up results. Candidate must cover at least one additional positive target in aggregate and lose none of the positive target coverage in static. A target already present in shared-first search cannot earn incremental credit by reappearing in either follow-up.
non_regression: Candidate loses none of the six distinct-control own-anchor coverage in matched shared-first-search union static-follow-up results, evaluated against shared-first-search union candidate-follow-up results.
Candidate does not increase cross-pair positive-target coverage among distinct controls; deduplicate each shared-first-search union follow-up PMID set identically for both arms.
Candidate does not increase the blinded unrelated-paper fraction among returned follow-up papers; incomplete blind labels make the outcome inconclusive.
Every returned paper has complete query, selected relaxation rung, selected/fetched/final PMID, source/tool, and actual server-process provenance.
outcome_criteria.shared_first_search_scoring: The identical shared-first-search set enters both arm coverage unions. Follow-up hits already present in that shared set cannot contribute an incremental gain or loss. Keep returned follow-up-paper blinded unrelated fractions as separately declared; no packet item may be missing a blind label.
outcome_criteria.failure_interpretation: A primary or non-regression failure rejects this exact frozen adaptation only. It does not establish that every iterative search method fails.
outcome_criteria.pass_interpretation: A pass retains the mechanism as promising only; no product adoption or release until the separately preregistered independent three-pair confirmatory comparison passes.
outcome_criteria.prospective_clarification: Independent review before any study3 scientific call found that counting a follow-up re-retrieval of a seed target could fabricate incremental prior-art discovery. Union/dedup prevents this, retaining original at-least-one improvement/no-loss/control/provenance thresholds. v1/v2 remain interrupted and are not retrospectively rescored.

stop_rules: Stop scientific requests on the first unresolved provider, model-admission, price, rate-limit, MCP retrieval, parser, trace, payload, process-attestation or provenance error. No transient Entrez error is retried or recovered.
Never retry a model, outer MCP call or Entrez request; never resume a consumed study, substitute routes/tools, or restart after admission. No recovery policy is authorized.
Any interruption after the one-shot admission marker leaves the pilot incomplete; do not replay it.
Require exactly one observed uncached provider response per model query, zero model/outer-call/Entrez retries and zero cache hits, and exact selected served-model identity.
Any nonzero billed/provider price evidence fails closed; model request caps remain zero for prompt, completion, and request.

campaign_admission.creation: Atomic exclusive-create before the first external model or MCP call.
campaign_admission.scope: One exclusive claim for prospective compact-output protocol9 and exact unchanged exposed development bank9; new output names never authorize replay.

cache_isolation.root: One fresh absolute, non-symlink, empty campaign cache directory, checked before admission.
cache_isolation.per_outer_call: Unique campaign nonce and outer-call-number slug/run ID across all 36 possible MCP calls; no result or shared cache reuse.

provenance.result_report: Private file with request parameters, exact query, model telemetry, papers/PMIDs for scoring, trace, validation outcome, and attested MCP serving PID/listener/source path/source tree.
provenance.blind_packet: Separate private file with randomized IDs and draft/title/abstract only; no arm, rank, PMID, or scorer IDs.
provenance.live_mcp_attestation: Pin the maintained MCP source tree/build ID; require one owned credential-free loopback process, working directory/import source, trace build ID and batch=1/recovery disabled/no study ID. Require empty isolated campaign cache before admission. Verify unchanged process/source/cache-root binding around each outer call; the strict per-slug raw trace proves fresh metadata origins and zero cache hits, while retaining trace and downloaded-cache artifacts.
provenance.raw_trace_gate: Use the pinned novelty_batch_trace.validate_batch_trace on the actual raw trace. Require exact selected-ID coverage, ASCII-numeric distinct ordered inputs, batches of at most nine, fresh EFetch requested/returned set equality (returned order may be shuffled), exact ELink coverage, one valid linked/no-link result per ID, no errors/incomplete/truncation/unknown cache origins, fresh per-slug cache isolation, and agreement between every returned pmc_full_text_id and the raw ELink result. Any mismatch stops before accepting the event or blind evidence. The raw wrapper ledger proves metadata EFetch/ELink batch counts only; it is not wire HTTP telemetry. Exclude PMC fulltext fetches and retstart pages from metadata counts; make no total-HTTP-count claim.
provenance.tool_run_id_namespace: Use distinct protocol9, admission, result and blind-packet paths. The maintained runner uses a fresh nonce and outer-call number for every MCP slug and m12_nov_v9 model telemetry run ID; no previous admission/result is reused.

source_evidence.source_metadata_preparation: Reuse canonical bank9 unchanged as exposed development. Existing source preparation and earlier exposure manifest describe historical intake before study8 only; not current freshness.
source_evidence.source_disjointness_baseline: Historical preparation-only manifest; study9 intentionally reuses all exact bank9 cases exposed by study8. No current-disjointness claim.

batch_trace_reader.role: Strict raw batch-trace validator for the actual maintained producer output.

source_evidence.reuse: Independently implemented external technique; no restricted source copied or Google-private-implementation claim.
source_evidence.selected_route: Selected Space Bunny Alpha / Stealth exact route is fixed; fresh live eligibility remains pending.
source_evidence.source_review_before_registration: Historical source review before bank9/study8 registration; separately review study9 frozen input reuse before registration.

launch_requirements: Recheck official zero-price catalog, active exact Stealth endpoint and read-only account projection immediately before any live batch.

Use one fresh empty isolated cache root before admission. Before and after each outer call verify the same process/source/cache root, and require the raw trace to prove a fresh per-slug pool, fresh metadata origin and no cache hits; retain per-call traces.

Verify unchanged model/prompt/request settings, batch-reader and maintained producer hashes, validator/parser/tool boundary and process/source/cache-root binding around each call. Require an empty campaign cache before admission, and fresh per-slug origins/no metadata cache hits in every retained raw trace; preserve traces and downloads.
Claim the one-shot admission before MCP initialize or any scientific call.
No model, outer-MCP or Entrez retries/recovery, route/tool substitution, paid service, consumed-study replay or historical rescoring.

offline_cli_preflight.scope: Actual isolated nonexecuting process/CLI/source/cache/environment; zero calls/admission/provider credentials.

offline_code_verification.scope: Accepted compact-output study9 dispatch and unchanged guard contracts, offline fakes only.

stop_rule_scope: Batching is an operational retrieval boundary, not a relaxed scientific threshold. No retry or recovery is enabled. Any unresolved error permanently stops this admission unscored; no partial scientific rejection/adoption or old-study replay.
registration_boundary: Effective only after independent study9 input acceptance, actual nonexecuting process readiness and exact canonical protocol9 plus unchanged committed bank9 bytes pass normal loaders. No replay, new bank or automatic inference.

private_to_canonical_conversion.bank_hash_binding: Private bank copy changes only status to OFFLINE for process preflight. Canonical bank9 is already committed; do not edit it. Bind its exact existing hash in canonical protocol9 after accepted preflight.
private_to_canonical_conversion.candidate_calls_authorized: False for private preparation; true in reviewed canonical registration only after committed normal loaders, then fresh current eligibility and exclusive admission authorize execution.
private_to_canonical_conversion.readiness_and_registration_receipts: Separate nonrecursive receipts bind private and exact canonical bytes; only administrative status/hash/readiness/review references change after preflight.

data_reuse.case_selection: All six pairs/original order; no subset or replacement.
data_reuse.confirmatory_requirement: Only scientific pass permits independently eligible unexposed three-pair confirmation before adoption/release.
